review_candidates.title: MES/EAP开发工程师
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 工作职责：（必备项：SECS/GEM，不看纯后端，谢谢） 1. MES系统开发与优化 - 负责MES系统的需求分析、功能设计、二次开发及日常运维，深入理解生产调度、工单管理、质量追溯、物料跟踪、生产报工等核心业务流程，持续优化系统功能，提升生产数字化管理效率。 - 独立完成MES与ERP、WMS、QMS、EAP、RMS等周边业务系统的数据接口开发、对接及集成，打通系统间数据壁垒，保障跨系统数据传输的实时性、完整性与准确性。 2. 设备自动化（EAP）与数据采集 - 负责EAP系统的方案设计、落地实施与迭代优化，实现生产机台与MES系统的全自动数据交互、指令下发与状态同步。 - 熟练掌握SECS/GEM协议及E5、E30、E37等相关标准，主导设备连机调试、报文解析及通信异常排查，确保设备状态、工艺参数及生产数据的实时采集与上报。 - 熟悉Modbus TCP/RTU、OPC UA、MQTT、Profinet等工业通信协议，快速解决设备通信中断、数据延迟等现场问题，保障采集链路稳定运行。 3. 现场支持与项目落地 - 负责MES、EAP系统在车间的部署、调试、上线及员工培训，提供7×24小时运维支持，快速响应系统故障及通信异常，保障生产不间断运行。 - 编写技术设计文档、接口文档、操作手册等全套资料，配合客户审厂、评审及验收工作，确保项目顺利交付。 任职资格: 1. 学历及工作经验 - 本科及以上学历，具备4年以上制造业软件开发或系统实施经验，有完整的MES及EAP系统独立开发与落地经验者优先。 2. 开发技能 - 熟悉Java或C#，具备扎实的编程功底，能独立完成后端服务开发及接口编写，熟练掌握Spring Boot或.NET Core。 - 熟练使用SQL Server、Oracle、MySQL等数据库，精通复杂SQL编写、存储过程开发及性能调优。 3. 工业协议与自动化能力 - 熟悉SECS/GEM协议及E5、E30、E37等相关标准，具备EAP开发、设备连机调试实战经验，能独立完成设备自动化通信搭建与问题优化。 - 熟悉Modbus TCP/RTU协议，具备现场设备数据采集与故障排查能力。 - 熟悉OPC UA、MQTT、Profinet等协议，了解西门子、三菱PLC通信原理及上位机对接。 4. 综合素质 - 具备优秀的业务理解能力和跨部门沟通协调能力，能精准拆解生产一线需求并转化为技术方案。 - 具备极强的现场故障排查与问题解决能力，工作严谨负责、抗压能力强，适应工厂现场工作节奏。 5. 优先条件 - 具备半导体、面板、光伏、精密电子、AR光波导等高端制造行业实施经验者优先。 - 具备赛美特、上扬、哥瑞利、鼎捷等主流MES/EAP厂商产品开发或实施经验者优先。 - 有0到1项目经验优先

review_candidates.title: Lodging Logistics/Linen/Water Delivery Supervisor
review_candidates.location: Al Dhafra, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
review_candidates.description: As the Lodging Logistics/Linen/Water Delivery Supervisor , you will support logistics services inclusive of water supply, lodging furniture moves, and linen services of personnel housed at ADAB. For logistics support of water, you oversee the water delivery team ensuring receipt and delivery of water pallets, managing inventory levels, and providing ready-to-order document for re-stocking requirements. In support of lodging furniture, you are responsible for storage, ordering, inventory, assembly & breakdown, installation, and removal & delivery of lodging furniture. Lodging furniture includes bed frames, refrigerators, dehumidifiers, nightstands, wall lockers and other related lodging furniture. Other duties may be assigned inclusive of assisting with other lodging duties inclusive of reservations, in-processing, out-processing of personnel lodged at ADAB. Other duties will also include placing work orders upon customer request for lodging facilities. Essential Job Functions As a Supervisor you shall determine quantities required and timely stock replenishment and rotation by use of experienced judgment, historical data, occupancy and utilization. You shall establish and maintain minimum stock levels of all expendable supplies and equipment to ensure adequate inventory of items with no more than two (2) unfulfilled lodging item requests due to depleted stock levels per month. Store, inventory, order, assemble, breakdown, remove, deliver, and install furniture, refrigerators, dehumidifiers, beds and other lodging related items in lodging rooms with no more than two (2) discrepancies per month. Maintain full inventory of lodging items in the storage facilities in an orderly manner with a system in place to account for all items with no more than two (2) discrepancies per month. Provide/oversee Water Delivery Services between the hours of 0700-1800 Monday through Saturday as needed. Responsible for delivery of water; responding to individual delivery requests; managing inventory levels; and providing a ready-to-order document to the Government for re-stocking requirements. You shall manage the water within the Class I storage area. Coordination to escort delivery trucks at the front gate and provide a USN Monitor of LNs/OCNs for the water delivery vehicles to one of the 3 water storage areas to ensure the water delivery contractor is always escorted. You will ensure the delivery trucks are fully escorted off the base after each water delivery has been completed. No escorting discrepancies allowed per month. Rotate the water pallets using the first in/first out method after each water delivery. Verify that no damage has occurred during delivery and after each pallet has been downloaded. Check that the shrink wrap integrity has been maintained for future pallet deliveries and sanitation. Remove one (1) bottle of water from each pallet and clearly mark it with the pallet number. You will then take each marked bottle of water and store them in the marked container for pickup by 380 ECES Bio Environmental to test the water. You shall contact 380 ECES Bio Environmental for water to be tested. You shall ensure all pallet and water bottles are marked with No discrepancies are allowed per month. You shall receive a confirmation from 380 ECES Bio Environmental that the water is suitable for consumption before it can be distributed and rotated into stock. The historical turnaround time for test results is 48-72 hours. As Supervisor, you shall manage a water delivery schedule for 110 identified facilities and drop off locations. You shall develop and submit the schedule to the COR for approval. You shall ensure all scheduled water drop areas are stocked with no more than two (2) stock outages allowed per month. Monitor and respond to emails or phone calls from requestors asking for pickup or delivery of water pallets for all the facilities at ADAB. Deliver water to / pickup water from each requested location within 24 hours after initial customer notification/request. Perform service with no more than two (2) late deliveries or pickups each month. Responsible for general cleanliness and trash removal, (cardboard, shrink wrap, etc.) from water delivery points to the appropriate dumpster. Collect empty water pallets and return to the vendor at the water storage areas daily. Education & Experience High School diploma or equivalent. 6K and 10K Forklift and 6K Boom lift experience (preferred). Previous military experience operating heavy equipment (preferred). Must have intermediate level skillset in computer functions including Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, Access, and PowerPoint. Additional Requirement Must possess a valid U.S. Driver’s License Possess a valid U.S. Passport (preferred) Must be able to meet all current USCENTCOM Deployment Policy Requirements, as outlined in the USCENTCOM APR 23 MOD EIGHTEEN TO USCENTCOM INDIVIDUAL AND INDIVIDUAL-UNIT DEPLOYMENT POLICY Able to obtain and maintain a valid Residency Visa for the U.A.E. Must be able to work in extreme environmental conditions including dust and high temperatures. Must be able to endure long hours, exposure to weather and hazardous conditions. TRAVEL: 100% Overseas Assignment SECURITY CLEARANCE: Must have and maintain a DoD Secret Clearance. Intrepid Acquisition Holdings, LLC www.intrepidgs.com Intrepid Acquisition Holdings, LLC. (IAH), is a leading provider of global-scale logistics, facilities management, and advanced professional and technical services. IAH provides a broad spectrum of services and solutions to U.S. and international government agencies, and organizations. As a world-class leader in providing seasoned program management, IAH leverages and integrates its capabilities to provide safe, innovative, and reliable solutions to meet customers' diverse and complex challenges. Intrepid Acquisition Holdings, LLC. (“IAH” and/or “Company”) and its affiliates, including but not limited to IAP World Services, Inc., Readiness Management Support L.C., JPATS Logistics Services, LLC., and subsidiaries is an EOE, including disability/vets. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

review_candidates.title: Government Affairs Lead - Middle East UAE Or Saudi Arabia Based
review_candidates.description: Job Description Who are we? Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! About The Role We are building a Government Affairs and Public Policy (GAPP) team with the ambition and expertise to help shape one of the world's most dynamic environments for artificial intelligence and digital innovation. As our Government Affairs Lead for the Middle East, you will help establish and strengthen Cohere's presence across the United Arab Emirates, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and the other Gulf Coast countries ensuring the company's voice contributes to the development of AI policy, digital transformation, public-sector innovation, procurement, and economic diversification initiatives. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced government affairs professional who thrives at the intersection of government, technology, and public policy, and who wants to help position Cohere as a trusted partner supporting the region's ambitions to become a global leader in artificial intelligence. You will work alongside experienced policy leaders, collaborate closely with senior executives, and contribute directly to Cohere's strategic growth across two of the world's fastest-growing AI markets. Key Responsibilities Report directly to Cohere's Head of EMEA Government Affairs & Public Policy, partnering closely with senior leadership, legal, public policy, responsible AI, communications, and commercial teams to develop and execute Cohere's government affairs and stakeholder engagement strategy across the UAE and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Serve as Cohere's primary government affairs representative across the region, building trusted relationships with ministries, regulators, government authorities, public-sector organizations, sovereign entities, and innovation agencies. Monitor and assess legislative, regulatory, and public policy developments affecting artificial intelligence, cloud computing, data governance, cybersecurity, digital infrastructure, and emerging technologies across the region. Support policy advocacy by developing consultation responses, policy submissions, briefing materials, executive talking points, and stakeholder engagement strategies related to AI regulation, digital economy initiatives, technology policy, and public procurement. Partner closely with commercial and public sector sales teams to support business development opportunities across government, financial services, telecommunications, energy, and other regulated industries. Collaborate with communications, marketing, and public relations teams to ensure consistent and effective messaging regarding Cohere's approach to responsible AI, innovation, and technology policy. Represent Cohere in industry associations, public-private partnerships, conferences, and policy forums across the Middle East. Develop and manage relationships with external government affairs consultants, advisors, and trade associations across the region. Ensure all government engagement, lobbying, and political activities are conducted in full compliance with applicable local laws, regulations, and company policies. Contribute to broader regional government affairs initiatives across the GCC and support cross-functional projects involving international stakeholders. Qualifications 7+ years of experience in government, a ministerial office, public policy, diplomacy, public-sector consulting, regulatory affairs, corporate government affairs, or a leading industry association. Strong understanding of the policymaking, regulatory, and public-sector landscape in either the United Arab Emirates or the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, with the ability to quickly develop expertise across both markets. Experience building trusted relationships with senior government officials and public-sector stakeholders. Familiarity with AI policy, digital transformation, innovation policy, cloud technologies, public procurement, or technology regulation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Professional proficiency in Arabic is highly desirable. Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate complex policy developments into clear business implications and actionable recommendations. A collaborative mindset and the ability to work effectively across international, cross-functional teams spanning multiple time zones. An entrepreneurial, self-starter mentality with excellent stakeholder management and project execution skills. Passion for artificial intelligence, emerging technologies, and the opportunity to help shape the policy environment supporting responsible AI adoption. An undergraduate degree in political science, international relations, public policy, law, business, economics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Preferred Qualifications Professional proficiency in Arabic. Existing relationships with government stakeholders in both the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Experience engaging with GCC institutions or regional organizations. Experience in enterprise software, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, or another emerging technology sector.
